definitions.short: to open up , i.e. (figuratively) interpret (a dream)
definitions.full: H6622. pathar מָּתַר verb interpret (dream), only Genesis 40:41 (Late Hebrew id. , Jewish-Aramaic מְּתַר ; apparently = Aramaic מְּשַׁר , , dissolve , figurative solve, interpret , compare מֵּשֶׁר ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular מָּתַר , with ל person Gen 40:22 ; 41:13 ; absolute מָּתָ֑ר 40:16 ; 41:12 ; with accusative of thing: Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּפְתָּרלָֿנוּ 41:12 ; Infinitive construct לִפְתֹּר 41:15 ; Participle active מֹּתֵר 40:8 ; 41:15 , ׳מּוֺ 41:8 .
